title: New-hire onboarding
text: When a hire is confirmed, the hiring manager asks People Ops to open an onboarding ticket. People Ops owns the ticket until the new hire is fully set up. IT ships the laptop and creates SSO and email accounts before day one. Warehouse access for analysts (the Snowflake ANALYST role on curated marts) is granted by Analytics Engineering, not Data Platform. The Analytics Engineering lead, or their delegate, approves it. Desks and badges come from Workplace. The goal is a fully set-up new hire within 2 business days of their start date.

title: Welcome lunch for new hires
text: A hiring team may host one welcome lunch during a new hire's first week. Spend is capped at $30 per attendee and 12 attendees, charged to the hiring team's events budget. Order from an approved caterer, normally Greenleaf Catering. Lunches with food must be held in The Commons, the only room where catering is allowed. The hiring manager approves the spend under the standard approval limits.

title: Data access tiers
text: Tier 1 is curated marts and dashboards. Analytics Engineering grants Tier 1 access after approval from its lead or their delegate, usually within one business day. Tier 2 is raw event tables and anything containing personal data. Tier 2 needs approval from the Data Platform lead and a written business reason. Data Platform owns pipelines and warehouse infrastructure but does not grant Tier 1 analyst access. Send pipeline failures to Data Platform and access or dashboard requests to Analytics Engineering.

title: Room booking and release
text: Book rooms through Workplace. If a meeting ends early or needs less time than booked, release the unused time so others can use it. Unused time of 30 minutes or more on a booking may be offered to another team, and the original booker is told. The Commons seats 30 and is the only room where catering is allowed. Rooms of 6 or fewer seats cannot be booked for more than 2 hours at a time.

title: Spending approval limits
text: Purchases under $500 need approval from the requester's manager. Purchases from $500 to $4,999 need approval from the department head who owns the budget. Purchases of $5,000 or more need approval from both the VP Engineering & Operations and the Controller in Finance. Spend is charged to the budget line of the team that benefits. A purchase may not exceed the remaining balance of its budget line without Finance approval.

title: Vendors and payments
text: Use approved vendors whenever possible. Adding a new vendor requires a Procurement review, which takes about 5 business days. Finance pays external vendors by invoice, card, or Solana devnet for vendors that accept it. Transfers between internal budget lines are made by Finance and need approval from both budget owners.

title: Out of office and delegation
text: Before time off, set your status to out, set a return date, and name a delegate. Until you return, your delegate may approve anything you could approve, up to the same limits. Requests routed to someone who is out go to their delegate, and the person who is out is copied on the result.

title: Checkout and payments incidents
text: Report checkout or payment problems to Commerce Engineering. Commerce triages the issue and escalates to Platform Engineering on-call if infrastructure is involved. Sev1 means customers cannot pay. Sev2 means checkout is degraded. Sev1 incidents need an update every 30 minutes. Commerce writes the postmortem within 5 business days.

title: Infrastructure incidents
text: Page Platform Engineering on-call directly through PagerLine for outages, deploy failures, or degraded infrastructure. The on-call engineer acknowledges within 10 minutes and owns the incident until it is resolved or handed off.

title: Who can see what
text: Every employee can see the directory, room availability, the policy handbook, and their own requests. Managers can also see their team's requests and their own budget lines. Finance can see all budget lines and vendor payments. The VP Engineering & Operations can see all departments' requests, metrics, and spend. Personal details such as time-off reasons are visible only to HR.

title: Laptops and accounts
text: IT provides one standard laptop from Northwind Devices to each employee. Ask IT for replacements, software licenses, and account problems. Accounts for new hires are created from the People Ops onboarding ticket. IT never grants warehouse or dashboard access. Send those requests to Analytics Engineering.
